add_metadata_to_mmcif: add AlphaFold metadata including license, citation, model info, and pLDDT metrics to an mmCIF dictionary
create_mmcif_metadata: create mmCIF metadata dictionary with ModelCIF conformation, authors, and software version from an existing cif mapping
run_mmcif_metadata_pipeline: run mmCIF metadata insertion with coevolution MSA, template search, and modeling protocol steps
summarize_mmcif_metadata: summarize the mmCIF metadata module that adds AlphaFold3 model metadata to mmCIF files
review_mmcif_metadata: review the add_metadata_to_mmcif function that enriches mmCIF data with ModelCIF-compliant metadata fields
